names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 4 Ιουνίου, «Όσιος Μεθόδιος ο εκ Ρωσίας», with the rank words left off.

death.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Οσιος Μεθοδιος ο Εκ Ρωσιας (; - 1392)» and the entry says he fell asleep in peace in 1392. The page gives no year of birth and dates his life to the fourteenth century.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιος Μεθόδιος ο εκ Ρωσίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. saint.gr's head line dates him «(; - 1392)» and the entry is two sentences. The monastery of Peshnosha, near Dmitrov in the province of Moscow, is named, and `locations` is left out. He is a Russian saint and the Russian calendar was not opened for this draft, which is what the `russian` row's note says. The corpus keeps a `methodius-of-patara` and nobody of Peshnosha. No hymn is printed.
